component 0: [["what is photosynthesis?", "Hi :), How can I help you?\n\nPhotosynthesis is the process by which green plants, algae, and chlorophyll-containing bacteria utilize sunlight to synthesize their own food (organic matter) from simple inorganic molecules. It releases oxygen as a byproduct, which is essential for aerobic respiration in all living organisms. This process is carried out by organelles called chloroplasts that act as solar cells producing carbohydrates."]]

[["what is glucose?", "Glucose is a type of carbohydrate that serves as the primary source of energy for cells in plants and animals. It's a simple sugar molecule (C6H12O6) that plays a crucial role in cellular metabolism, including photosynthesis and respiration. Glucose is also an important food source for many organisms on Earth."]]
